ns2:course.label: Nutrition and the Life Cycle
ns2:course.description: Examines physiological changes that occur during gestation, postnatal growth, and aging and the influence of these changes on nutritional requirements. Prerequisite: FSHN 120 or FSHN 220 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FSHN 120 or FSHN 220 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Food Science or Human Nutrition or Dietetics or Food Science or Nutrition or Dietetics and Nutrition or Nutrition & Health major(s) or minor(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
